name: domain-discovery
title_zh: 动代码之前先把业务黑话挖清楚的考古笔记
tagline_zh: 接手陌生模块时最怕的不是看不懂代码，是看不懂词。它先翻代码、翻文档、翻历史，把「这个词到底指什么。
tagline_en: Before designing anything, it digs through code, docs and history to pin down what each term really means and who.
desc_en: Semantically investigate a problem and the existing codebase before technical design, producing or updating docs/domain/DOMAIN.md. Use for domain discovery, investigation, archaeology, or clarification of concepts, states, invariants, language, and sources of truth. Invoke manually with /domain-discovery.
why_zh: 它不产出代码，只产出共识：概念、状态、不变量、语言、真相来源，五样分开列，歧义当场标出来而不是留给你猜。
why_en: It ships no code, only consensus: concepts, states, invariants, language and sources of truth listed separately, with.
limit_zh: 只写文档不写代码，也不做技术设计；产出固定落在 docs/domain/DOMAIN.md 一个文件里。
limit_en: Docs only, no code and no technical design; output lands solely in docs/domain/DOMAIN.md. If the repo has no readable clues and nobody can answer.
title_en: Domain archaeology notes before you touch the code
